title: Active Document Window State

oracle.positive: Switch active document changes title and unsaved indicator without stale UI refs
oracle.negative: Close document with unsaved changes requires explicit decision

reviewer.role: project owner (human reviewer) running the app on Windows

checks_run: RED: cargo test -p om9-app --test document_window_state -> 8 passed; 1 failed. The one product defect: after opening a file the document kept the name 'Untitled'.
GREEN: cargo test -p om9-app --test document_window_state -> 9 passed; 0 failed (W1..W7 title and switch, C1..C9 the close decision)

cargo test --workspace -j 2: every group ok (the host paging file cannot hold the default parallel workspace build: os error 1455; -j 2 is the working invocation and is recorded in the regression log)
cargo check --workspace --all-targets: exit 0; cargo fmt --check: exit 0; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0
real windows: L3-002 size matrix 14/14 PASS; L3-003 panel scenarios 7/7 PASS
code_change: session/files.rs::replace_from_file now gives the loaded document the name of the file it came from (bounded to 240 characters), so the title, the status line and a later Save As name the same document. Before, opening first.om9 left Document::name as 'Untitled'.
No other product behaviour changed: the title rule, the send-only-on-change rule and the whole close decision state machine already existed and are now pinned by fixtures.

manual_reviewer_checklist.scope_note: The title string and the decision state machine are machine-proven; the window manager's title bar and the look of the prompt are the owner's to confirm.

items.step: Start the app without a document and read the title bar.
items.machine_proven: W1: the title is 'OpenMatrix9 — Untitled' and the document is clean.
items.human_must_verify: The title bar really shows that text (never empty) and no ' *' is present.

items.step: Draw something, watch the title, then Save (or Save As) and watch it again.
items.machine_proven: W2/W3/W4: the marker appears while the document differs from its file, disappears after the save, and the file name replaces the document name.
items.human_must_verify: The title bar updates at once, names the file and drops the marker after saving.

items.step: Open another document while the current one has unsaved changes, choose Discard, then look at the title, the layers list and the undo state.
items.machine_proven: W5: the title, the document name, the entity count and the undo journal all belong to the newly opened document; nothing of the old one is left.
items.human_must_verify: The window really shows the opened file everywhere (title, layer list, objects) and Undo has nothing from the previous document.

items.step: Move, roll up, dock and float menus, then look at the title.
items.machine_proven: W6: panel placement never makes the document dirty.
items.human_must_verify: The title keeps no ' *' after rearranging menus, and running a file command afterwards does not ask to save.

items.step: With unsaved changes, close the window and answer Cancel, then Discard, then (with unsaved changes again) Save.
items.machine_proven: C1..C9: a dirty close asks first; Cancel leaves everything alone; Discard closes without writing; Save writes and then closes; a clean close never asks; a stale answer cannot close or save anything.
items.human_must_verify: The prompt is clear, Cancel really keeps the app open with the work intact, Discard does not write, and Save writes before closing.

environment_note: cargo test --workspace exhausts this host's paging file (os error 1455) unless it runs with reduced parallelism; `cargo test --workspace -j 2` passes and is what the regression log records.
